title: Thai-style Crispy Arancini Fritters
description: Crispy fried risotto balls filled with a Thai-inspired mixture of egg and spices. Serve as a crunchy snack or side dish.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
2. Chop the leftover arancini into small pieces and set aside.
3. In a bowl, mix together the curry paste, egg, chopped plants, and Italian seasoning.
4. Add the chopped arancini to the bowl and mix until well combined.
5. Shape the mixture into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
6. Roll each ball in the bread crumbs to coat.
7. Fry the arancini balls in batches until golden brown and crispy.
8. Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
